statements.status_notes: wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 is a transitive dependency from upstream DataHub GMS 1.4.0.3. The legacy wire-runtime-jvm coordinate has no fixed version reported by Scout; the upstream replacement path is a migration to com.squareup.wire:wire-runtime 6.3.0 or later. Investigating a safe migration path that does not break DataHub compatibility.

wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 is a transitive dependency from upstream DataHub GMS 1.4.0.3. The legacy wire-runtime-jvm coordinate has no fixed version reported by Scout; the upstream replacement path is a migration to com.squareup.wire:wire-runtime 6.3.0 or later. Investigating a safe migration path that does not break DataHub compatibility.

CVE-2026-45799 is a missing negative-length check in com.squareup.wire ByteArrayProtoReader32.skipGroup() and ProtoReader.skipGroup() that throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException outside the documented IOException boundary when a crafted protobuf payload includes an unknown START_GROUP field with a negative LENGTH_DELIMITED varint. DataHub's mae-consumer never calls ProtoAdapter.decode (no com.squareup.wire imports anywhere in datahub-project/datahub at v1.5.0.7) and consumes only Avro-serialized Kafka events (MetadataChangeLog, MetadataAuditEvent, PlatformEvent) via Confluent kafka-avro-serializer; its only HTTP surface is Spring Actuator on the bootJar. wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 lands on the runtimeClasspath (not compileClasspath) purely as a transitive of the wire-compiler codegen toolchain pulled in by the Pegasus/Gradle plugin graph; the JAR is shipped but no DataHub or Pegasus code reaches its decoder (LinkedIn rest.li ships its own com.linkedin.data.protobuf.ProtoReader and does not depend on Square Wire). Upstream marks wire-runtime-jvm as discontinued with no patched release; the supported replacement com.squareup.wire:wire-runtime fixed in 6.3.0 is not on DataHub's dep graph and a forced upgrade would not affect a code path that is never invoked.
